not-an-object.why: The contract is a list, not an object

bad-tier.expect: "tier" must be a whole number from 1 to 4

bad-sequence.why: Sequence must be main or side

bad-hint-kind.why: Not one of the four hint kinds

missing-mode.why: An item with no spoiler tag

bad-id.why: ID with capitals and a space
bad-id.expect: "id" must be a lower-case kebab-case ID

correct-not-boolean.why: correct must be true or false

duplicate-item-id.why: A hint reuses a truth ID
duplicate-item-id.expect: ID "truth-a" is already used by truths[0]

missing-truth.why: A hint points to a truth that does not exist

points-to-hint.why: An understanding points to a hint, not a truth

too-many-truths.why: A main contract with 3 truths in reader mode
too-many-truths.expect: needs 1 or 2 truths in reader mode, found 3

no-truths-in-mode.why: A main contract with no truth in spoiler-free mode
no-truths-in-mode.expect: needs 1 or 2 truths in spoiler-free mode, found 0

truth-without-hint.expect: truths[1] (truth-b): no hint points to it in reader mode

only-misreadings.why: Truth B can only be misread
only-misreadings.expect: truths[1] (truth-b): no correct understanding of it in reader mode

hint-only-in-reader.why: Truth A is shown in both modes, but all its hints are reader-only
hint-only-in-reader.expect: truths[0] (truth-a): no hint points to it in spoiler-free mode

item-wider-than-contract.why: A reader-only contract with an item tagged both
item-wider-than-contract.expect: would show it outside its contract, which is "reader"

spoiler-leak.why: A hint tagged both points to a reader-only truth
spoiler-leak.expect: hints[2] (hint-b1): mode "both" would show it where its truth "truth-b" (mode "reader") is hidden

duplicate-contract-id.why: Two files share one contract ID
duplicate-contract-id.expect: contract ID "example-contract" is also used by
